label: Charles d'Amboise

claims.statement: French governor of Milan. Asked Florence for Leonardo in 1506 and employed him as painter and engineer.

sources.cite: First chronology draft (Leonardo Chronology, 2026-10-09), entered from model recall. Basis stated in the draft: Correspondence between Milan and Florence.

claims.statement: Letters to the Florentine Signoria requesting extension of Leonardo's leave; a letter of 16 December 1506 praising Leonardo is often cited. New edition by Fagnart and Miesse 2015.
